name: Payment Method Invocation Migration
description: In PayFlow SDK v2.0, the deprecated 'client.charge.create(...)' method was removed and unified under 'client.payments.create(...)'.
fix_strategy: Change attribute access from 'charge.create' to 'payments.create'. Ensure arguments conform to PF-002 if 'amount_cents' is present.

name: Payment Argument Rename & Currency Enforcement
description: In PayFlow SDK v2.0, 'amount_cents' is renamed to 'amount'. Additionally, 'currency' is now a mandatory parameter (standard default is 'USD' if omitted in v1).
fix_strategy: Rename 'amount_cents' keyword argument to 'amount'. If 'currency' keyword is missing, add currency="USD".

name: Exception Hierarchy Modernization
description: PayFlow v2 replaced the legacy 'PayFlowError' base exception with 'PayFlowAPIException'. Catching or raising 'PayFlowError' will miss runtime errors or fail syntax in v2.
fix_strategy: Replace imports and except handlers referencing 'PayFlowError' with 'PayFlowAPIException'.

name: Client Initialization Config Object Overhaul
description: PayFlowClient in v2 no longer accepts direct keyword arguments like 'apiKey' or 'api_key'. It strictly requires a 'ClientConfig' configuration object instance passed to 'config'.
fix_strategy: Import 'ClientConfig' from 'payflow.config' (or 'payflow.client') if not imported. Wrap the api key in 'ClientConfig(api_key=...)' passed as 'config' argument.

name: Customer Retrieval Method & Parameter Standardization
description: PayFlow v2 deprecated 'client.customers.retrieve(id=...)' in favor of 'client.customers.get(customer_id=...)'.
fix_strategy: Rename method 'retrieve' to 'get' on customers service, and rename parameter 'id' to 'customer_id'.

name: Refund Method Deprecation
description: PayFlow v2 replaced singular 'client.refund.process(charge_id=...)' with plural service 'client.refunds.issue(payment_id=...)'.
fix_strategy: Change 'client.refund.process' to 'client.refunds.issue' and rename 'charge_id' parameter to 'payment_id'.
